name: Setup check
why: The setup check a thread passes before work: route, variables, network, script, start
ideal: A thread reads its cloud rules, holds no key in a variable, and starts fast on a narrow network.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Configure cloud environments
Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Say
steps.rule: A thread reads its GitHub route, network, variables and local-thread rules.

steps.name: Variables
steps.rule: No environment variable holds a key.

steps.name: Network
steps.rule: The allow list holds only hosts a thread calls.

steps.name: Script
steps.rule: The setup script adds little time to a start.

steps.name: Start
steps.rule: A thread reaches its first tool call within a minute.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: No file a thread needs is missing from the repo.
